description: The review of one coding solution: component assessments and the solution's complexity. There is no score: the system computes it from the ratings, the test results it measured itself, the verified key points and the factual errors.

keyPoints.description: One verdict for every expected key point, judged before the ratings.

evidenceQuote.description: The candidate's own words, copied exactly, that show the key point; null when MISSING.

codeAnalysis.description: What the solution does, decided before the ratings.

approach.description: One sentence: the algorithm and data structures the solution uses, at most 300 characters.

timeComplexity.description: The solution's worst-case time complexity in Big-O notation, for example O(n log n).

spaceComplexity.description: The extra memory the solution uses in Big-O notation, for example O(n).

claim.description: What the candidate said that is wrong.

sources.description: Tokens (r1, r2, ...) of the reference passages that support the correction; empty when it is judged from your own knowledge.

repeats.description: The token (m1, m2, ...) of the earlier mistake of this interview that this statement repeats; empty when it repeats none.

factualErrors.description: Misconceptions: technically wrong statements in the answer.

ratings.description: One rating per criterion of the rubric (filled in per request).

candidateClaims.description: Statements the candidate made about their own experience, at most 300 characters each.

summary.description: One sentence, at most 500 characters, on what the answer showed.

confidence.description: How sure you are of this judgement, decided last. It is your own estimate and changes no rating.

reason.description: One short sentence: what makes the judgement easy or hard to be sure of; at most 300 characters.
